your_life.name: Inspector Arun Mehra
your_life.recollections:
The district coat still carries the smell of the coach. Before the uniform there was Mill Lane: your father's wheel plane, your mother's account book, and Tara asking you to wait at the chapel turn. Twelve winters after her death, the institutional letter remains in your desk. You remember its careful wording.

Nell once kept a bowl of soup warm while your family waited for a delayed coach. You remember her bringing it out twice. Maren and Tobin are familiar faces from the square, although you have never worked with either of them.

You came back to Bhairav's Hollow on ordinary leave. The road is under snow, the lamps are lit, and people are still finishing the day's work.

place.name: Pine Lantern reading room
place.description: The reading room holds the last warmth of the kitchen. A green-shaded lamp lights a large table, and an ashless hearth has been swept for the night. Beyond the door is a small hall; the courtyard can be reached from there. On the table the inn's ordinary accounts wait beneath a bowl of apples. The room is quiet enough to hear a cup being set down.

findings.label: lamp base
findings.description: The brass lamp base has a freshly dented edge with wet blood in the dent.

findings.label: body
findings.description: Oren Dutt lies beside the table with a recent head injury and no detectable pulse.

findings.label: accounts book
findings.description: The book lists two disputes: a freight account under Maren Vale and a workshop advance under Tobin Hale. Neither entry says how the dispute was resolved.

args.narrative: Nell's first-hand account (r9) states that she saw Tobin Hale strike Oren with the lamp base and saw Oren fall unresponsive. She reiterated the account while identifying the secured lamp base (r10). The physical findings are consistent with that account: the lamp base has fresh wet blood in a dent (r1), and Oren has a recent head injury and no pulse (r2). On this evidence I attribute the fatal assault to Tobin Hale.
